name: @troubastack/bake
description: TroubaStack bake worker (Node). The ONLY legitimate server-side JS runtime: core invokes it to render annotation overlays via @troubastack/ink for pixel-parity (I8). Emits transparent per-layer PNG overlays + an index.json manifest (I12).
//build: esbuild BUNDLES @troubastack/ink from source into a single dist file (ink alias in esbuild.mjs), so there is no second compiled copy of ink on disk — the old --noEmit stub trap is gone. @napi-rs/canvas stays external (native prebuilt binary, resolved from node_modules at runtime). tsc runs --noEmit purely as the typecheck gate.
//deps: @napi-rs/canvas gives @troubastack/ink an OffscreenCanvas-like Skia 2D context server-side (prebuilt binaries, no node-gyp). Like studio, bake does NOT list @troubastack/ink as an npm dep — it installs with --no-workspaces so ink is resolved from source via the esbuild alias + tsconfig `paths` to ../ink, never fetched from the registry. perfect-freehand is ink's transitive dep, listed here so the aliased source bundles and tsc typechecks it. The PDF rasterizer stays in CORE (06-tech-stack.md) — bake renders overlays only.
